papers.title: Adipose tissue-resident Tregs orchestrate metabolic flexibility through IL-33-driven remodeling

papers.title: Single-nucleus atlas of the aging human liver reveals hepatocyte zonation collapse

papers.title: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation coordinates thermogenic beige adipocyte identity
papers.abstract: Very-long-chain fatty-acid handling by peroxisomes is identified as a rate-limiting step for beige adipocyte thermogenesis in vivo.

papers.title: IL-6 trans-signaling drives hepatic insulin resistance through a STAT3-SOCS3 loop

papers.title: MASH resolution after GLP-1 receptor agonism is associated with hepatic macrophage reprogramming

papers.title: Mitochondrial quality control safeguards adipocyte insulin responsiveness during nutrient excess

papers.title: Spatial transcriptomics resolves fibrogenic stellate-cell niches in metabolic liver disease

papers.title: T cell states in human white adipose tissue track metabolic health independently of body mass
